summary: The sitemaps {feedpath} (an absolute sitemap URL) is percent-encoded exactly once, by the shared path-parameter helper; commands must not pre-escape it.
reason: Once replacePathParam began encoding every path parameter, the earlier command-level url.PathEscape made feedpath double-encoded (%252F), and Google rejects submit/get/delete with HTTP 400 "Could not process sitemap".
validated_outcome: webmasters_sitemaps_test.go asserts %2F on the wire and no %25; a live submit-sitemap against sc-domain property returns 204 and get-sitemap reports 0 errors.
